test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What conclusion can be drawn from the premises 'All teachers are hardworking persons' and 'Most hardworking persons are woman'?
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fa7302933e73c59a4bfb4c4d0abb40c6c4f2e49a119f9cff75c8bccfbe569a4.png] 

By checking options:

Conclusions:

(1) No teacher is a woman → False (it is possible as shown in the above diagram but not definite as some woman can be teacher is true as shown below)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3aa95c93e7742794d9c994f1b27d11d15b3ac4f2f8f2cb94c07cb51b0d14a3ad.png] 

 

(2) All teachers are women → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the above diagram)

(3) All women are hardworking persons → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the above diagram)

(4) Some women are hardworking persons → True (as most hardworking persons are woman)

Hence, option (4) is the correct answer.
